description.en: Android desktop companion for dsh-pet: a transparent overlay that mirrors the in-page pet (animations, speech bubbles, visibility, size) and feeds messages back into the DSH conversation. Ships a 53 KB shell APK that the user must install once (Android requires confirmation).
description.zh: dsh-pet 的安卓桌面端：用透明悬浮窗养同一只宠物，动作、气泡、显示位置、尺寸都与页面里那只双向同步，并能把桌面输入的话送进 DSH 会话。附带 53KB 壳 APK（Android 要求用户确认安装）。
